name: Local gates before cloud mutation
proof: Green local checks and a current deploy preflight report.
safety: No remote mutation happens in this stage.

name: Vercel project link and env sync
proof: .vercel/project.json exists locally and env values are pulled outside git.
safety: Vercel credentials stay in the shell, Vercel dashboard or ignored local files.

name: Supabase intake persistence
proof: Brief intake variables exist in the production provider secret store.
safety: Service role keys remain server-only and never enter client bundles.

name: Custom server static fallback dry-run
proof: Dry-run output confirms target path and file delta before upload.
safety: Live rsync remains blocked until the user confirms host, path and output.

name: Rollback bundle and source share
proof: GitHub branch SHA and iCloud bundle path point to the same clean head.
safety: Rollback remains available even if managed hosting or custom server deploy is delayed.
